identificationModule.officialTitle: A Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Effectiveness of CD19- BCMA CAR - T Cells Immunotherapy in Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Acute B Lymphocytic Leukemia

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: A non randomized study ,plans to enrollment 24 subjects of acute B lymphocytic leukemia .The subjects will divide into low, medium and high dose groups，to evaluate the safety and tolerability of CD19-CD22 CAR - T cells，to evaluate the preliminary efficacy and observe PK/PD parameters of CD19-CD22 CAR -T cells immunotherapy in patients with relapsed or refractory acute B lymphocytic leukemia .

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: According to the sequence from the low dose group to the high dose group
